label: Product SKU
purpose: Display the selected variant's SKU on the product page
_notes: The SKU value itself comes from the real product/variant data in Shopify, not from AI-generated content — there is no text field to fill. The block's only real setting, text_style (body/subtitle/uppercase), is pure typography, as are margin_top/margin_bottom. This block needs no content input from the AI; leave its settings object empty.
